title: The Law of the Grain Offering
description: The Lord gives the law concerning the grain offering to Moses: Aaron's sons are to present it before the altar, burn a handful of flour mixed with oil and frankincense as a memorial portion, and eat the remainder unleavened in a holy place within the courtyard of the tent of meeting. It is their share of the Lord's fire offerings; anything that touches them becomes holy. There is also a special rule for the daily grain offering of the anointed priest: one-tenth of an ephah of fine flour, half offered in the morning and half in the evening, prepared with oil, which must be burned completely and not eaten.
